complete_five_bodies.name: iterate_fixed_regret
complete_five_bodies.review: Use fixed sharp. V subset X and strict convexity produce convexity; terminal state interior gives membership and true derivative. divergence_nonneg and eta>0 prove nonnegative terminal quotient, then linarith drops only this term.

complete_five_bodies.name: iterate_variable_regret
complete_five_bodies.review: Define M by sup' over nonempty range T. le_sup' supplies hbound internally. Invoke variable sharp; show T-1<T and positive last step. Prove terminal divergence nonnegative and remove only its quotient.

complete_two_canaries.name: decreasing_signed_run
complete_two_canaries.body_review: Complete body inspected. Reuses only applicable fixed-run facts, changes f1 to -5z/4, proves its properness/global support and actual second objective minimum. The factorization is (z-1/2)^2*((z+1/2)^2/2+5/4); the positive factor proves uniqueness. none is ruled out by an explicit attained minimizer; some p is identified by uniqueness. It constructs states through 2 and played positivity/nonincrease. Both maxima are proved with upper bounds and attained witnesses. hsharp and hprinted call variable_sharp and variable_regret. All 22 constructor entries accounted for.
